definitions.gloss: farming village, agricultural community, rural area
definitions.explanation: A village or community where agriculture is the main occupation and way of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農村|のうそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: My grandparents live in a farming village.

examples.japanese: {農村|のうそん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The migration from rural areas to cities continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農村|のうそん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Aging is advancing in Japan's rural farming communities.

notes:
USAGE: {農村|のうそん} specifically refers to communities centered on agriculture, distinct from general countryside.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {農村|のうそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in a farming village)
- {農村|のうそん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (rural agricultural area)
- {農村|のうそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (rural life)

COMPOUNDS:
- {農村|のうそん}{部|ぶ} (rural farming district)
- {農村|のうそん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (agricultural zone)
- {農村|のうそん}⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ (rural development)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農村|のうそん} - farming village (agriculture-focused)
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧ - countryside (general)
- ⟦{漁村|ぎょそん}→漁村：noentry⟧ - fishing village
